source: US Census Bureau TIGERweb AIANNHA, current vintage

properties.censusName: Prairie Band of Potawatomi Nation Off-Reservation Trust Land
properties.populationNote: Not counted. This land was added to the Census's map after the 2020 count, so no census population for it has been published.
properties.districtsNote: None. The Census draws no tribal district on this land, so no council seat belongs to it.
properties.rosterWhy: The nation publishes its council on its own site, which answers every request from this project with a Cloudflare challenge — robots.txt and the front page alike, HTTP 403, three reads sixteen seconds apart. An access control is not worked around, so no name is carried and the card links the nation instead.
